explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/41: Erdős proved that if pairwise sums are distinct aside from trivial coincidences then liminf |A ∩ {1,…,N}|/N^{1/2} = 0. The statement uses `NtupleCondition A 2`, the Sidon condition. The ratio is bounded because Sidon sets have count ≪ N^{1/2}, so the real liminf is meaningful. Faithful.
